newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon weekly CDs raise 62 bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon weekly CDs raise 62 bln pounds.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon issued certificates of deposit dated October 18 to commercial banks worth 62 billion Lebanese pounds compared with 34 billion last week.
The Bank sold 45-day CDs worth six billion pounds compared with one billion last week. It sold 60-day CDs worth 56 billion pounds compared with 33 billion last week.
Interest rates on the 45- and 60-day CDs were 12.75 percent and 13.50 percent respectively, unchanged for the sixth week running.
